full_judgment:
The petitioners obtained these Rules from a judgment of reversal. 

 5. Mr AJ Mohammad Ali, learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners, argues that the Court of appeal below erred in law in dismissing the suit for Specific Performance of Contract on misreading Exhibits 1,2 and X which has occasioned a failure of justice. Learned Advocate further argues that the Court of appeal below erred in law in assuming that the time is the essence of the contract while dismissing the suit for specific performance. He finally submits that the Court of appeal below has committed error of law resulting an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice in allowing the appeals without reversing all the findings arrived at by the trial Court and therefore, the judgment of the Court of appeal below is not a proper judgment of reversal.
